performance.driver: Total revenue increased to $1.6 billion for the first quarter, reflecting an increase of 6% over the prior year period.

REVENUE, NET AND GROSS MARGIN Revenue, net in fiscal 2026 increased by $80.9 million, or 6.4%, compared to the prior year. The increase was primarily due to an improvement in net revenue per active client of 7.8% year over year and higher average order values, driven by the number of items kept by our clients per Fix increasing and higher average unit retail prices.
